title: Yijing
subtitle: Pilgrim, translator and witness to maritime exchange
shortSummary: Yijing connects maritime pilgrimage, learning in South Asia and the production of Chinese Buddhist translations.
curatorialDescription: Placed beside Xuanzang's overland experience, Yijing shows that Sui–Tang Buddhist knowledge moved through more than one route.
The museum separates pilgrimage narratives, translation work and later biography instead of treating a travel story as complete history.
researchNote: Alpha entry; specific editions, folio references and route nodes for the Record of Buddhist Pilgrims and translation catalogues remain to be verified.
